summary: Quiet residential kerb on a steep street, homes 24 m or more away.
reasons: Quiet residential street, few parked cars

drivers.seclusion: Mapped homes 24 m or more away on both sides of the road, but houses all round and the south ones look onto it.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed through street; the kerb looks wide enough to park along, though a driveway and bushes line the south edge.
drivers.convention: One ute parked at the western bend; otherwise few cars park along it.

flags: Homes within about 25 m all round
sun_shade: Mostly open; trees shade parts of the south edge in the afternoon.

best_section.where: Straight middle of the south kerb, below the tree-lined verge
